responsibility: This file implements structured printing of an entire RTL function in a textual form intended to be both human-readable and machine-parseable. It emits function headers, parameter RTL and incoming RTL, wraps the insn chain in explicit basic-block directives with incoming and outgoing edge metadata, and prints selected extra CRtl state such as return_rtx, using the reusable rtx_writer infrastructure and an optional compact format. Its responsibility is whole-function RTL dump serialization, distinct from the lower-level generic RTL node formatting in print-rtl.c.
